content.description: Duelist King will be powered by a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO), an Oracle and Random Number Generator.It is the first generational chain-agnostic NFT card game that aims to transform the way people play, participate and earn in card games. To achieve full democratizationall decisions made on the card issuance, distribution and proceeds allocation are governed by decentralized mechanics on blockchain with proven fairness, transparency and best interests for the community.
